detail.title: GWGT5 Racing Steering Wheel with Pedals & PS5 Adapter - 270°
detail.overview: The Ant Esports GWGT5 is a full-featured racing wheel bundle that includes pedals, a gear shifter and a PS5 adapter, giving it out-of-the-box compatibility across PS5, PS4, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PC and Nintendo Switch. A 270-degree rotation range paired with dual vibration motors delivers realistic haptic feedback synced to in-game action, while six suction cup mounts anchor the wheel firmly to a desk or table for stable, wobble-free play during intense races. The bundled gear shifter and dedicated pedal set add an extra layer of control beyond a standard controller, making it a strong pick for anyone setting up a home sim racing station across multiple consoles.
